notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content: [p]The demo has been translated to simplified and traditional Chinese.[/p][p][/p][p]Bug fixes include:[/p][list][*][p]Preventing overflow of text[/p][/*][*][p]Timescale issues when using certain gadgets and opening blocking UI at the same time[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemies not detecting player again after loosing detection of player once[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dialogue of pirate stations not being displayed in the right order[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed main menu buttons being displayed while settings are still open after changing resolution[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemies spawning initially even though player is too far away [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content: [h1]Bug fixes[/h1][list][*][p]NPC Dialogue is now displayed correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Bug that let players get stuck in black holes is fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Bug that let players move through walls inside the hidden vaults is fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Bombs in planets and gadget bomb now destroy tiles in a certain radius[/p][/*][*][p]Resources dropped by lootboxes when the players storage is already full can now be collected again[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Improved User Experience[/h1][list][*][p]UI Element that displays the current amount of XP[/p][/*][*][p]An additional button for flying more slowly, allowing for more control[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies loose detection of the player at a certain distance[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial dialogue explaining how charges work was rephrased to be clearer [/p][/*][*][p]Projectiles are now slower[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue can now be skipped using E instead of left mouse button to allow one-handed control [/p][/*][*][p]Backgrounds of planets are now darker to make them more distinguishable[/p][/*][/list]
